jobs.description: MOV.AI technology | making ROS enterprise grade " " Skip to content Products ROS-based visual IDE Autonomous Navigation and Perception Deployment & Installation Tools Fleet Management and Robot Operations Technology Partners Resources Blog Videos ROI Calculators Company About us News & Updates Careers Contact us CVD Policy Flow™ Schedule a Demo Products ROS-based visual IDE Autonomous Navigation and Perception Deployment & Installation Tools Fleet Management and Robot Operations Technology Partners Resources Blog Videos ROI Calculators Company About us News & Updates Careers Contact us CVD Policy Flow™ Products ROS-based visual IDE Autonomous Navigation and Perception Deployment & Installation Tools Fleet Management and Robot Operations Technology Partners Resources Blog Videos ROI Calculators Company About us News & Updates Careers Contact us CVD Policy Flow™ Schedule a Demo TECHNOLOGY Simplifying the robot development process ROS is an excellent framework for writing robot software, with its tools, libraries, and conventions that aim to simplify the task of creating complex and robust robot behavior across a wide variety of robotic platforms. We take it one (or ten) steps further, turning ROS into a full-blown Robotics Engine Platform that allows you to easily develop enterprise-grade robotics software. The Robotics Engine Platform enhances ROS in the following dimensions: Process abstraction Abstraction and separation of ROS processes and states. This allows assigning a timeline to ROS processes . Processes can now be turned on and off sequentially or per state, making ROS much more efficient. Software containerization Opening the door to versioning, software lifecycle management, debugging, ease of upgrades and rollback, as well as security support. Software virtualization Enabling several key capabilities including advanced simulation, adoption of continuous integration, continuous deployment, and continuous testing practices. Multi-protocol support - Plug-in System Enables simple integrations and interfaces with external systems, including anything from ERP to individual robots. Through the plug-in system, you can operate complex collaborative environments. Visual user interfaces Intuitive visual interfaces designed to support different system users, simplifying tasks and reducing the risk of errors. Ready to build awesome robots? jobs.title: About us
jobs.description: MOV.AI | About us - THE FREEDOM TO CREATE GREAT ROBOTS " " Skip to content Products ROS-based visual IDE Autonomous Navigation and Perception Deployment & Installation Tools Fleet Management and Robot Operations Technology Partners Resources Blog Videos ROI Calculators Company About us News & Updates Careers Contact us CVD Policy Flow™ Schedule a Demo Products ROS-based visual IDE Autonomous Navigation and Perception Deployment & Installation Tools Fleet Management and Robot Operations Technology Partners Resources Blog Videos ROI Calculators Company About us News & Updates Careers Contact us CVD Policy Flow™ Products ROS-based visual IDE Autonomous Navigation and Perception Deployment & Installation Tools Fleet Management and Robot Operations Technology Partners Resources Blog Videos ROI Calculators Company About us News & Updates Careers Contact us CVD Policy Flow™ Schedule a Demo Our Story It all started when Limor Schweitzer decided to build a Robot. Limor, an experienced technology entrepreneur who knows a thing or two about robots, identified the potential of Autonomous Mobile Robots (AMRs) and decided to build one. But when he sat down to start developing the software with ROS, Limor and the team discovered that AMRs are stuck in the previous century – closed products that perform one predetermined task – and that ROS itself is lacking many tools to develop an AMR that will meet enterprise-grade needs. As the team developed their robot, they also built ROS-based tools to make their lives easier. True to open source culture, they shared the tools with the ROS community The responses they got made it clear that they weren’t the only ones suffering from the lack of tools, and a ROS-based enterprise-grade Robotics Engine Platform ROS was born. MOV.AI is changing AMRs as we know them. It provides AMR developers and integrators with the tools they need to create and deploy great robots quickly, allowing users to benefit from automation products that are as agile as the times. Born out of an unmet need, MOV.AI is a Robotics Engine platform based on ROS and packaged in an intuitive web-based interface. It contains everything needed to build, deploy and operate intelligent robots. MOV.AI completely changes the way Autonomous Mobile Robots are developed, in terms of time to market, cost, and flexibility. Investors Join us Careers Facebook Twitter Linkedin Youtube Join Us! jobs.title: CVD Policy
jobs.description: CVD Policy - MOV.AI " " Skip to content Products ROS-based visual IDE Autonomous Navigation and Perception Deployment & Installation Tools Fleet Management and Robot Operations Technology Partners Resources Blog Videos ROI Calculators Company About us News & Updates Careers Contact us CVD Policy Flow™ Schedule a Demo Products ROS-based visual IDE Autonomous Navigation and Perception Deployment & Installation Tools Fleet Management and Robot Operations Technology Partners Resources Blog Videos ROI Calculators Company About us News & Updates Careers Contact us CVD Policy Flow™ Products ROS-based visual IDE Autonomous Navigation and Perception Deployment & Installation Tools Fleet Management and Robot Operations Technology Partners Resources Blog Videos ROI Calculators Company About us News & Updates Careers Contact us CVD Policy Flow™ Schedule a Demo CVD Policy Coordinated Vulnerability Disclosure Policy At MOV.AI, we are committed to the safety, security, and resilience of our robotics middleware, Autonomous Mobile Robot (AMR) software ecosystems, and corporate infrastructure. In alignment with international standards (ISO/IEC 29147) and the European Union Cyber Resilience Act (CRA) , we welcome disclosures from independent security researchers, customers, and the global DevSecOps community to help us protect our ecosystem. If you believe you have discovered a security vulnerability impacting a MOV.AI product or asset, we encourage you to report it to us safely and confidentially using the guidelines below. What we expect from you MOV.AI deeply values the work of ethical security researchers. If you conduct your vulnerability research and make your disclosure in accordance with the rules of engagement outlined in this policy, we commit to the following: No Legal Action: We will consider your research authorized and will not initiate or support legal action against you regarding your discovery. Confidentiality: We will protect your identity and work with you to understand and remediate the issue before public disclosure. Coordination: We will keep you updated as we triage, validate, and patch the vulnerability. Rules of Engagement & Robotics Safety Guardrails Because MOV.AI software controls physical industrial equipment and automated robotics systems, security testing carries unique, real-world physical risks. You must strictly adhere to the following constraints: ⚠️ All vulnerability research must be strictly confined to virtual simulations, isolated local testing containers, or sandboxed development environments. Under no circumstances should security testing, fuzzing, or active scanning be performed on live production systems, active customer warehouse deployments, or physical industrial equipment in operation. Prohibited Activities To maintain Safe Harbor protection, you must not engage in: Denial of Service (DoS/DDoS) attacks that disrupt corporate or customer operations. Social engineering, phishing, or physical security attacks against MOV.AI employees, facilities, or partners. Exfiltration, modification, or destruction of corporate or customer data. If you accidentally access private data, halt your research and notify us immediately. Submitting raw, unvalidated outputs from automated vulnerability scanners without manual analysis or proof-of-concept validation. How to Submit a Report To ensure your submission reaches our DevSecOps Response Team with zero latency, submit your report directly into our portal: MOVAI Security Service Desk Note: Alternatively, you can transmit your findings via email to our inbound team here Facebook Twitter Linkedin Youtube Join Us!
